context:
👾因為Chained together自己也有參賽
於是在下場前找了🌸☄️代打主持⋯
理由是因為🌸和🚑之前也(痛苦地）
配信多次玩了這個遊戲
意思是說👾覺得要找🌸主持這段沒錯
但找了🌸就一定要找☄️的！
所以👾在去玩Chained together 之前
先把🌸☄️兩人Chained together

Since👾was also participating in Chained Together, 👾decided to find🌸and☄️as substitutes to host before the match. The reasoning was that 🌸 and 🚑 had previously (and painfully) streamed this game multiple times together.

In other words, 👾 thought it made sense to have 🌸 host this segment, but if they were going to involve 🌸, they absolutely had to bring in ☄️ too! So, before heading off to play Chained Together, 👾 first “chained together” 🌸 and ☄️.
這算某種技能了吧
在眾人都在講話很吵的狀況下
🌸很小聲的說了一句彗醬我肚子餓了
☄️馬上有反應
說我也餓啦
現在誰可以去預約一下燒肉
🌸聽到馬上興奮大喊   燒肉！

This could be considered a skill, right?
In the middle of a noisy situation where everyone was talking, 🌸 quietly muttered, “Suichan, I’m hungry.”

☄️ immediately responded, saying, “I’m hungry too! Who can make a reservation for Yakiniku right now?”

As soon as 🌸 heard that, she excitedly shouted, “Yakiniku!”
